purpose: estimator comparison on the identical locked-point administered sets
rationale: Pick the estimator whose recovery slope is closest to 1. LOCKED to MWLE (slope=0.921). Slope closest to 1 among the four is 'mle' (slope=0.927); when that is MLE it is REJECTED because plain MLE diverges on all-pass/all-fail administrations (unbounded theta), whereas MWLE's Warm penalty stays finite -- matching the Bridge & BiGGen deployment choice.
